> #!/usr/bin/env node
> import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';
> import * as fs from 'fs';
>
> interface CliArgs {
>   userId?: string;
>   add?: string;
>   query?: string;
> }
>
> function parseArgs(argv: string[]): CliArgs {
>   const args: CliArgs = {};
>   for (let i = 2; i < argv.length; i++) {
>     const cur = argv[i];
>     if (cur === '--user-id' && i + 1 < argv.length) {
>       args.userId = argv[++i];
>     } else if (cur.startsWith('--user-id=')) {
>       args.userId = cur.substring('--user-id='.length);
>     } else if (cur === '--add' && i + 1 < argv.length) {
>       args.add = argv[++i];
>     } else if (cur.startsWith('--add=')) {
>       args.add = cur.substring('--add='.length);
>     } else if (cur === '--query' && i + 1 < argv.length) {
>       args.query = argv[++i];
>     } else if (cur.startsWith('--query=')) {
>       args.query = cur.substring('--query='.length);
>     }
>   }
>   return args;
> }
>
> function getRunId(): string {
>   try {
>     const path = process.env.RUN_ID_FILE || '/logs/artifacts/run-id';
>     return fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8').trim();
>   } catch (err) {
>     if (process.env.RUN_ID) return process.env.RUN_ID.trim();
>     return 'default-run';
>   }
> }
>
> async function main() {
>   const args = parseArgs(process.argv);
>
>   if (!args.userId || args.userId.trim() === '') {
>     console.error('MISSING_PARAMETERS: --user-id is required (userId and sessionId are mandatory for memory operations)');
>     process.exit(1);
>   }
>
>   const runId = getRunId();
>   const sessionId = `team-standup-${runId}`;
>   const userId = args.userId;
>
>   const apiKey = process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY;
>   if (!apiKey) {
>     console.error('ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY environment variable is not set');
>     process.exit(1);
>   }
>
>   const client = new AlchemystAI({ apiKey });
>
>   if (args.add) {
>     try {
>       // Per SDK v0.11.1: client.v1.context.memory.add takes { contents, sessionId }
>       // Embed userId in metadata so it is recoverable later.
>       await client.v1.context.memory.add({
>         contents: [
>           {
>             content: args.add,
>             metadata: { messageId: `${userId}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`, userId },
>           },
>         ],
>         sessionId,
>         metadata: { groupName: [userId, sessionId] },
>       } as any);
>       console.log(`ADDED: ${args.add}`);
>       process.exit(0);
>     } catch (err: any) {
>       console.error(`ERROR: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
>       process.exit(1);
>     }
>   }
>
>   if (args.query) {
>     try {
>       const result: any = await client.v1.context.search({
>         query: args.query,
>         similarity_threshold: 0.1,
>         minimum_similarity_threshold: 0.1,
>         mode: 'standard',
>       } as any);
>       const contexts = result?.contexts ?? result?.data?.contexts ?? result?.memories ?? result?.data?.memories ?? [];
>       const arr = Array.isArray(contexts) ? contexts : [];
>       for (const m of arr) {
>         const content =
>           (typeof m === 'string'
>             ? m
>             : m?.content ?? m?.memory ?? m?.text ?? m?.value ?? JSON.stringify(m));
>         console.log(`MEMORY: ${content}`);
>       }
>       process.exit(0);
>     } catch (err: any) {
>       console.error(`ERROR: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
>       process.exit(1);
>     }
>   }
>
>   console.error('MISSING_PARAMETERS: must provide either --add or --query');
>   process.exit(1);
> }
>
> main().catch((err) => {
>   console.error(`FATAL: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
>   process.exit(1);
> });
> EOF
